_comment: Synthetic. Invented objectives and key results. See README.md.
_status_note: An objective's status is one of draft, active, met, missed, dropped — the vocabulary frozen at P0 and enforced by a CHECK constraint in 0002_domain.sql. There is deliberately no at_risk: risk is derived from the two progress numbers and how much of the period is gone (ADR-0013), not declared. Being at risk does not change what an objective is.

objectives.title: Be measurably fitter by the end of the year

keyResults.statement: Strength session three times a week
keyResults._note: A habit, not an outcome. Should become a Ritual — exercises the habit/outcome distinction in ADR-0012.

objectives.title: Put the household finances on a deliberate footing

keyResults.statement: Six months of expenses held in reserve

objectives.title: Protect time with the people who matter

keyResults.statement: One uninterrupted evening together each week
keyResults._note: Large divergence: most tasks closed, little felt progress. The exact pattern ADR-0013 exists to surface.

objectives.title: Contribute regularly to the neighbourhood association
objectives._note: No key results and no initiatives — exercises orphan detection in W11. It must stay *active*: the orphan question is asked of objectives that have been committed to, and a draft with nothing behind it is a draft rather than a finding.
